atomicPointerAndLkgModel.atomicity: Every switch is compare-and-swap on expected targetKey, expected pointerDigest, and expected generation. Immutable generation bytes are written and verified before CAS. A CAS mismatch denies without retrying against a newly observed pointer; a new explicit operation is required.
atomicPointerAndLkgModel.acceptance: A ring candidate may be active only for its exact ring assignments while lkgPointer remains the prior accepted generation. After the final allowed ring's postcondition and readback pass, a separate CAS sets activePointer and lkgPointer to the candidate and binds the matched Verification Fabric LKG pointer/readback.
atomicPointerAndLkgModel.noPriorLkg: Initial activation may proceed only with complete evidence and explicit assignment. If it faults before acceptance and no prior healthy LKG exists, disable the affected target; never select another installed generation by version or recency.

beforePointerSwitch: Do not change activePointer or lkgPointer.
Remove only owned staged candidate bytes and temporary records.
Verify zero owned residue and emit rolled_back receipt for the candidate; if cleanup readback fails, disable the affected target.
afterPointerSwitchBeforeAcceptance: Freeze the failing candidate and deny further traffic for the exact affected target during recovery.

Verify prior lkgPointer is COMPLETE, not stale/revoked, and exactly binds the prior lockIdentity, packageDigest, UpdateTupleV1, assignments, authority profile, Verification verdict/evidence, and pointer generation.
Execute the fixed hash-chained sequence STAGE_COPY, VERIFY_STAGED, SWITCH_POINTER, VERIFY_POSTCONDITION, ROLLBACK_LKG, CLEANUP.
Compare-and-swap activePointer from the failing candidate to that exact prior lkgPointer; never resolve latest, nearest compatible, or any other installed generation.
Restore exact profile, adapter, pack, route, assignment, policy/authority, schema, and generation tuple from the LKG contract.
Read back exact pointer, immutable files, tuple, assignments, authority profile, route health, Verification LKG pointer/readback, and cleanup residue.
Report rolled_back only when all readbacks match and residueCount is zero; terminal journal state is ROLLED_BACK_ZERO_RESIDUE.
exactRollbackSemantics.afterFinalAcceptance: The accepted candidate becomes the new lkgPointer only after final allowed ring readback and acceptance CAS. A later provisional update rolls back to that accepted pointer. Historical generations may be retained immutably but are not selectable unless they are the exact recorded LKG for the operation.
exactRollbackSemantics.unrecoverable: If no exact healthy prior LKG exists, if any rollback binding/readback fails, or if cleanup leaves residue, disable the smallest affected profile, adapter, pack, or route and deny. Broad fallback, partial success, and best-effort version selection are forbidden.
